posts.trend: Gurgaon woman spends 50% of salary on rent to live close to work: ‘Saving my peace’
posts.context: We pay a premium to live close to the office to save time, only to give that saved time right back to the employer.
posts.angle: The walk to work is shorter, but you still end up staring at the same glowing rectangle until midnight.
slides: "Bro, office ke paas room lene se life set ho gayi hai."

"Yes, rent is ₹50,000."
"But my peace of mind is priceless."
"Subah bas utho aur nikal jao."
"I have time for gym, cooking, and reading."

You are currently eating cold Maggi at 11:45 PM.

The office laptop is open.
posts.caption: Ask the friend who moved to Cyber City to save time what they did with those three hours today.
posts.rank_verdict: The multiple lines of dialogue in the first two slides feel like a script transcript rather than a sharp, deadpan observation.
